title: Fixtures, Isolation & Flaky Tests
objectives: Build deterministic fixtures with factories and transactions
Diagnose the four classic flake causes

examples.name: factory.rs

exercise.prompt: Match each flake to its cause: "fails only at midnight UTC", "passes alone, fails in suite", "fails on airplane wifi", "fails 1/50 runs locally".
hints: Wall-clock and timezone edges are time flakes.

questions.prompt: The most robust way to give each DB test a clean slate is…
options: wrap each test in a rolled-back transaction
questions.explanation: Transactional rollback is fast and guarantees identical starting state per test.

questions.prompt: Why replace sleep(150) with waiting for observable state?
options: sleeps are both slow and racy; awaiting state is deterministic
questions.explanation: Fixed sleeps guess at timing; awaiting observable state is correct at any speed.
